title: Fingerprint
description: Domain-specific hashes for one characterised system (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §22). A `null` hash means 'not computed', never 'empty'. From crates/kakashi-core/src/fingerprint.rs. Only source_sha/dependency_sha/config_sha/environment_sha are populated by this build (kakashi-observe); interface_sha/behaviour_sha/binary_sha are always null today (§22 not yet fully implemented).
